changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE matches ( match_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, game_id TEXT NOT NULL, players TEXT[] NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('ACTIVE','FINISHED')), started_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, finished_at TIMESTAMPTZ, current_round INT NOT NULL, max_rounds INT NOT NULL, width INT NOT NULL, height INT NOT NULL, winner TEXT, result JSONB );
CREATE INDEX matches_started_at_desc_idx ON matches (started_at DESC);
